title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1979-08-12
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (row 13, seats 68 & 69 - 1st set held head high, 2nd set mounted on pole)> Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXLII)

ai_review.summary: Wide‑open soundboard recording captures a feistier Brent‑era Dead, highlighted by a soaring Estimated Prophet and standout playing from Jerry, Phil and Bobby.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the summer‑'79 tour with Brent as a refreshingly energetic set, noting that Phil Lesh sounds “oversaturated” but inspired, while both Jerry Garcia and Bob Weir shine on Estimated Prophet. The soundboard source is described as “awesome,” wide open and virtually free of audience noise, giving listeners a clear sense of the band’s dynamics.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; it rates the show 4 stars and lauds the recording quality, leading to a balanced 4‑star overall rating with low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Wide open mix with minimal audience bleed; crisp dynamics allow hearing nuances as if seated in the 12th row.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Ordinary setlist elevated by feisty playing and tight band chemistry, especially with Brent's seamless integration.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Shines on Estimated Prophet; guitar dynamics captured vividly.
band_member_comments.Phil: Sounds oversaturated but full of life; his bass lifts the performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Excels on Estimated Prophet alongside Jerry.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent fits in naturally, adding to the band's feisty energy.
band_member_comments.Drums: Tight and “invisible,” providing a solid rhythmic foundation.
